name: mtch-stream-control
description: Local control server for the Mitchtopia stream overlays. Runs on the streaming PC, serves the overlay to OBS and a control panel to your phone.
_comment_scripts: Use `npm run dev` while building - Node's built-in --watch restarts the server whenever a watched file changes, so there is no Ctrl+C and re-run cycle. Use `npm start` when actually streaming: a stray file save should not drop the overlay's websocket mid-broadcast.
